activity_summary: You kept a copy of the four lines. They name Wednesday the twenty-sixth, Oxford, the bridge on Friday by dusk, Hobbins on Saturday, and the money in your own hand. The long letter is still on the board, with no day, and it did not go.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Copied the four lines and left the old letter where it was.

facets.activity: Copied the four lines that went with Hobbins

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It has no day. It did not go.
